description: This file contains unit tests for the ProjectAPI class in the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It uses PHPUnit to test CRUD operations such as create, get all, get one, update, and delete, utilizing mock services and fixtures.

classes.name: ProjectAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the ProjectAPI endpoints related to project management in the Time module ROI of OrangeHRM.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by clearing the entity manager before each test.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests the creation of a project via the API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestCreate
methods.description: Provides test cases for the create project test.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests retrieving all projects via the API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test cases for getting all projects.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieving a single project by ID through the API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetOne
methods.description: Provides test cases for getting a specific project.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestUpdate
methods.description: Provides test cases for updating a project.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests deleting a project via the API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestDelete
methods.description: Provides test cases for deleting a project.
